rep.access_hint: Who can open it: give "View report" to roles, departments or people in Roles & Permissions.
rep.active_desc: An inactive dashboard is hidden from everyone.
rep.cache_hint: Each viewer's result is reused for this long. Empty or 0 always reads afresh.
rep.chart_alt: Chart of the report; switch to Table to read the values.
rep.columns_hint: With nothing grouped, the report lists records with these columns.
rep.count_hint: Leave empty to count records; choose a field to count the records where it has a value.
rep.dashboard_access_hint: Who can open it: give "View dashboard" in Roles & Permissions. Each report widget also needs "View report".
rep.dashboard_empty_text: The widgets of this dashboard are not shared with you.
rep.dashboard_subtitle: Arrange reports and notes on a twelve-column grid.
rep.dashboards_empty_text: Create a dashboard to show several reports together.
rep.dashboards_intro: A dashboard arranges reports and notes on a grid. Each widget can be limited to some roles.
rep.delete_dashboard_text: Its reports stay; only the dashboard is removed.
rep.delete_text: It is removed from every dashboard and menu that shows it, and nobody can open it any more.
rep.editor_subtitle: Choose what to group by and what to work out, or list records with their linked values.
rep.export_failed: The file could not be made.
rep.filters_hint: Only records that match every filter are read.
rep.form_hint: The records the report reads. It can also read the forms they link to and the forms that link to them.
rep.group_hint: Up to three. A date can be grouped by period.
rep.insights_empty_text: Reports and dashboards appear here when an administrator shares them with you.
rep.insights_subtitle: The reports and dashboards shared with you.
rep.key_hint: Used in configuration packages. It cannot change after saving.
rep.layout_hint: Drag a widget to move it, or use its arrows. Select a widget to change it.
rep.limit_hint: Groups, or records in a list. Empty shows all.
rep.name: Name
rep.no_widgets_text: Add a report or a note.
rep.pick_linked_field: Choose a field of the linked form
rep.preview_empty_text: Choose what to show, then run the preview.
rep.preview_failed: The preview could not be run.
rep.preview_hint: Runs the report as you, on the records you can see.
rep.reports_empty_text: Create a report to count, add up or list the records of a form.
rep.reports_intro: Each report has its own permission, "View report", given in Roles & Permissions. A viewer only ever sees their own records and the fields they may see.
rep.series_cut: The chart shows the first {n} series; the table shows them all.
rep.show_legend_desc: Names the series under the chart.
rep.show_totals_desc: A last row in the table with the values over all records.
rep.show_values: Show the values on the chart
rep.show_values_desc: Each bar, point or slice is labelled with its value.
rep.stacked_desc: The series of each group are drawn on top of one another.
rep.subtitle: Reports read any form or collection, through its links, and show the result as a table, a pivot table, a chart or key figures. Dashboards bring several together.
rep.truncated: The report stopped after {n} records; narrow it with filters.
rep.values_hint: What to work out for each group: a count, a total, an average, the lowest or the highest.
rep.viz_hint.area: Like a line chart, with the area under each line filled.
rep.viz_hint.bar: One grouping along the bottom; a second grouping or several values become the bars of each group.
rep.viz_hint.kpi: One to four values over all records, shown as large figures.
rep.viz_hint.line: Best for a date grouped by day, week, month, quarter or year.
rep.viz_hint.pie: One grouping and one value: the share of each group.
rep.viz_hint.pivot: Two groupings: the first down the side, the second across the top.
rep.viz_hint.table: A table of groups and values, or a list of records when nothing is grouped.
rep.widget_roles_hint: Leave empty to show it to everyone who can open the dashboard.
